findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_my_current_policy · Public sink: start_malpractice_quote, check_my_current_policy, grade_dental_contract_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_my_current_policy · Public sink: start_malpractice_quote, check_my_current_policy, grade_dental_contract_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
